text:
deploy-bot: Deploy attempt to canary environment blocked — CI gate failed for commit a1b2c3d (tag: release/v1.8.2). Failing jobs: e2e-frontend (flaky), lint (error). Holding rollout.

olivia: Which e2e tests failed? Can you paste logs?

ci-bot: e2e-frontend/should_render_card: timeout after 90s
ci-bot: e2e-frontend/checkout_flow: flaky assertion on `.total`
ci-bot: lint: src/components/Card.tsx:42:9 - 'foo' is defined but never used

samir: @olivia @maria grabbing the logs now. If e2e is just a timeout we can rerun the job; lint needs a patch.

olivia: Can we pin canary to the previous working commit while we sort this? release/v1.8.1 was stable.

ben: We can rollback canary to a1b2b2b, but FYI change window ends in ~90m. Quick rerun might be faster.

maria: Lint looks like a generated helper slipped in. I'll open a tiny PR to remove the unused var.

samir: kicking off a rerun for the failed jobs: `ci rerun e2e-frontend --job 14`

deploy-bot: Rerun started by samir for e2e-frontend. Monitoring.

ci-bot: Rerun update: e2e-frontend retried — one job passed, one still flaky. lint job remains failing. :warning:

olivia: OK pause the automated rollout, pin canary to release/v1.8.1, and block auto-rollout until PR #4123 merges. Need manual approval to rollback.

ops-bot: Manual hold placed by olivia. Policy: manual-approval-required. Suppressing canary alerts for 15m.

ben: Approved rollback. Rolling back canary to a1b2b2b now. I'll update release notes and incident log.

deploy-bot: Rollback started to commit a1b2b2b. ETA ~3m.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete — canary running at a1b2b2b. Release pinned to release/v1.8.1; automated rollout paused. :white_check_mark:

maria: PR #4123 opened: "fix(lint): remove unused var in Card.tsx" — linking to this thread. Will merge after CI passes.

samir: After PR merge we'll run a controlled canary retry with `--no-automate` and watch e2e flakiness. Also will mark checkout_flow as flaky in the harness.

olivia: Thanks — documenting the incident in #release-notes.

ben: Follow-up task created: INF-231 - increase timeout for checkout_flow and add retry logic in test harness.

deploy-bot: Thread closed. Last action: rollback completed and canary pinned to release/v1.8.1.
